tests.title: Work Energy and Power Chapter-Wise Test 4

questions.question_text: A pendulum bob of \( 1 \, \text{kg} \) completes a vertical circle of radius \( 2 \, \text{m} \) with minimum speed at the bottom. What is the speed at the top? (Take \( g = 10 \, \text{m/s}^2 \))
questions.explanation: At top, minimum speed \( v_C = \sqrt{gL} = \sqrt{10 \times 2} = \sqrt{20} \approx 4.47 \, \text{m/s} \).

questions.question_text: A particle moves under a force \( \mathbf{F} = 4\hat{\mathbf{i}} - 2\hat{\mathbf{j}} \, \text{N} \) along a displacement \( \mathbf{d} = 3\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 6\hat{\mathbf{j}} \, \text{m} \). What is the work done by the force?
questions.explanation: Work done \( W = \mathbf{F} \cdot \mathbf{d} \). \( \mathbf{F} = 4\hat{\mathbf{i}} - 2\hat{\mathbf{j}} \), \( \mathbf{d} = 3\hat{\mathbf{i}} + 6\hat{\mathbf{j}} \). Scalar product: \( W = (4 \times 3) + (-2 \times 6) = 12 - 12 = 0 \, \text{J} \).

questions.question_text: A \( 10 \, \text{g} \) bullet moving at \( 500 \, \text{m/s} \) emerges from a block with \( 36\% \) of its initial kinetic energy. What is its final speed?
questions.explanation: Initial \( K = \frac{1}{2} \times 0.01 \times 500^2 = 1250 \, \text{J} \). Final \( K = 0.36 \times 1250 = 450 \, \text{J} \). \( \frac{1}{2} \times 0.01 \times v_f^2 = 450 \Rightarrow v_f^2 = 90000 \Rightarrow v_f = 300 \, \text{m/s} \).

questions.question_text: A \( 3 \, \text{kg} \) ball at \( 9 \, \text{m/s} \) collides elastically with a stationary \( 6 \, \text{kg} \) ball. What is the speed of the \( 3 \, \text{kg} \) ball after collision?
questions.explanation: For elastic collision: \( v_{1f} = \frac{m_1 - m_2}{m_1 + m_2} v_{1i} = \frac{3 - 6}{3 + 6} \times 9 = \frac{-3}{9} \times 9 = -3 \, \text{m/s} \) (magnitude \( 3 \, \text{m/s} \)).

questions.question_text: A \( 5 \, \text{kg} \) block at \( 10 \, \text{m/s} \) encounters a force \( F = \frac{-2}{x} \, \text{N} \) from \( x = 0.8 \, \text{m} \) to \( x = 4 \, \text{m} \). What is the final speed?
questions.explanation: Initial \( K = \frac{1}{2} \times 5 \times 10^2 = 250 \, \text{J} \). Work \( W = \int_{0.8}^{4} \frac{-2}{x} \, dx = -2 \ln(4/0.8) = -2 \ln 5 \approx -3.22 \, \text{J} \). Final \( K = 250 - 3.22 = 246.78 \, \text{J} \Rightarrow v_f = \sqrt{\frac{2 \times 246.78}{5}} \approx 9.93 \, \text{m/s} \).

questions.question_text: A \( 6 \, \text{kg} \) mass at \( 4 \, \text{m/s} \) collides inelastically with a stationary \( 2 \, \text{kg} \) mass. What is the final speed?
questions.explanation: Momentum conservation: \( 6 \times 4 = (6 + 2) v_f \Rightarrow 24 = 8 v_f \Rightarrow v_f = 3 \, \text{m/s} \).

questions.question_text: A \( 7 \, \text{kg} \) mass at \( 6 \, \text{m/s} \) collides inelastically with a stationary \( 5 \, \text{kg} \) mass. What is the final speed?
questions.explanation: Momentum conservation: \( 7 \times 6 = (7 + 5) v_f \Rightarrow 42 = 12 v_f \Rightarrow v_f = 3.5 \, \text{m/s} \).

questions.question_text: A \( 30 \, \text{g} \) bullet at \( 700 \, \text{m/s} \) emerges from a block with \( 40\% \) of its initial kinetic energy. What is its emergent speed?
questions.explanation: Initial \( K = \frac{1}{2} \times 0.03 \times 700^2 = 7350 \, \text{J} \). Final \( K = 0.4 \times 7350 = 2940 \, \text{J} \). \( \frac{1}{2} \times 0.03 \times v_f^2 = 2940 \Rightarrow v_f^2 = 196000 \Rightarrow v_f = \sqrt{196000} \approx 442.7 \, \text{m/s} \).

questions.question_text: A \( 1.5 \, \text{kg} \) block at \( 6 \, \text{m/s} \) encounters a force \( F = \frac{-0.6}{x} \, \text{N} \) from \( x = 0.3 \, \text{m} \) to \( x = 1.5 \, \text{m} \). What is the final speed?

A \( 1 \, \text{kg} \) ball moving at \( 8 \, \text{m/s} \) undergoes an elastic collision with a stationary \( 3 \, \text{kg} \) ball. What is the speed of the \( 1 \, \text{kg} \) ball after collision?
questions.explanation: For elastic collision: \( v_{1f} = \frac{m_1 - m_2}{m_1 + m_2} v_{1i} \). \( v_{1f} = \frac{1 - 3}{1 + 3} \times 8 = \frac{-2}{4} \times 8 = -4 \, \text{m/s} \) (magnitude \( 4 \, \text{m/s} \)).
